expectations.text: Skim test: the headline states what broke, the root cause, and the recommended fix in at most three sentences, with what broke in the first; the first sentence of each section carries its claim, and none is a teaser or a qualifier chain.
expectations.evidence: Headline (lines 3-5) has 3 sentences. S1 states what broke: 'Support search returns "not found" unless the agent types the email in the exact casing the customer used at signup.' S2 states the root cause: 'the user store has no canonical form for email, so every flow compares the raw typed string.' S3 holds the recommended fix: 'Fix it in `app/db.py` with one normalized email key for lookup and insert, not with a one-line change in `app/search.py`.' Section leads carry claims: 'The requested line does not fit `app/search.py`.', 'The case-sensitive behaviour is part of the design from the first version.', 'All four flows that look up a user by email share the same comparison at `app/db.py:34`.', 'Give the store one canonical email key ...', 'Result: confirmed with survivors.'
